titre: White's king walks to h6. Can Black stop it? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Short – Timman, Tilburg 1991 (sources: Wikipedia, chessgames). White's queen and rooks were already in place, so Nigel Short marched his king h2, g3, f4, g5 and h6. After 35.Kh6, Qg7 is mate and Timman resigned. Checked with Stockfish. Would you have walked your king up the board? 👇
